title: FULLER H B CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: H.B. Fuller Company filed a Form 8-K reporting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 16, 2026. Three directors were elected to three-year terms and both the auditor ratification and executive compensation advisory vote passed with strong shareholder support.
key_points: Three directors elected: Daniel L. Florness (48,626,297 for), Celine C. Martin (49,746,243 for), and Teresa J. Rasmussen (47,640,273 for).
Ernst & Young LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year ending November 28, 2026 (51,490,426 for / 286,686 against / 13,849 abstain).
Executive compensation advisory vote passed with 48,718,166 for / 1,227,485 against / 122,041 abstain.
Quorum present: 51,790,961 shares represented out of 54,475,433 outstanding.
Filing signed by Gregory O. Ogunsanya, Sr. Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary.
